card.name: First digit of a statistic number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number inside a percentage or p-value in clinical trial results, such as the 1 in 14% or the 0 in p=0.0168. It also fires on the decimal point in 0.2%.

modes.label: Percent in patient counts
modes.description: Leading digit of a percentage in parentheses after a patient count.

modes.label: P-value digits
modes.description: The zero after the decimal point in a p-value following a confidence interval.

card.writes: It pushes toward unusual number-continuation tokens, with no clear link to the next digit.
card.plain: It marks the start of a percentage or p-value number in trial result tables and text.
